text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
Kwame, you're remembering right that Bettina said 12, but she corrected it. On 2025-11-17 in this channel she posted "Saltmarsh Provisions discount is 12% now." Five minutes later she wrote: "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%. Misread the draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark."

So the only figure in this channel is **10%**, and the 12 was a misread of a draft worksheet. That correction is almost a year old. I can't see any Saltmarsh contract or order form in the files I can read, so I can't confirm 10% is still the current rate, for example after an amendment. For the renewal brief, check the signed contract with June Osei-Lark on deal desk before you quote it.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
